rules.name: Revoked Agent Intercept
rules.message: Access Denied [SEC-R01]: Agent credentials have been permanently REVOKED or DECOMMISSIONED by account administrator.

rules.name: Unauthorized Scope Intercept
rules.message: Access Denied [SEC-R02]: Agent lacks permission scope for this action. Restricted by Principle of Least Privilege.

rules.name: Transaction Hard Cap Exceeded
rules.message: Transaction Blocked [SEC-R03]: Order amount exceeds hard maximum budget ceiling of ₹25,000. High-risk AI purchase halted to prevent runaway financial liability.

rules.name: Daily Spending Limit Hard Cap
rules.message: Transaction Blocked [SEC-R04]: Cumulative 24-hour spend exceeds maximum daily limit of ₹50,000. Spend velocity throttling enforced.

rules.name: Non-Returnable Category Check
rules.message: Return Blocked [SEC-R05]: Item category is non-returnable (Perishable Grocery / Personal Hygiene) under Amazon India terms.

rules.name: Return Window Expired
rules.message: Return Blocked [SEC-R06]: Request exceeds standard Amazon India 7-day return eligibility window.

rules.name: High Value Purchase Step-Up Approval
rules.message: Customer Approval Required [SEC-R07]: Order amount exceeds automatic allowance threshold of ₹5,000. Human verification requested.

rules.name: Unverified Shipping Address
rules.message: Customer Approval Required [SEC-R08]: Delivery PIN code is not in customer's pre-verified address book.

rules.name: High Risk Category Step-Up
rules.message: Customer Approval Required [SEC-R09]: Cart contains high-risk or restricted goods (Jewelry / Luxury). Human confirmation required.

rules.name: High Value Refund Approval
rules.message: Customer Approval Required [SEC-R10]: Refund amount exceeds automatic threshold of ₹2,000.
